images.title: Add 3 each time
images.purpose: Show five terms 4, 7, 10, 13, 16 with the same jump of 3 between neighbours and the next term 19.
images.composition: One horizontal number row with five boxes and a dashed sixth box, curved arrows above, centred with space around.
images.exact_structure: Six equal square boxes in a row, evenly spaced. The first five hold 4, 7, 10, 13, 16 in teal #0072B2. The sixth is dashed grey #6B7280 and holds 19 in amber #E69F00. Five equal curved arrows above join each box to the next, each marked +3. Exactly 6 boxes, 5 arrows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a jump of any number other than 3
images.takeaway: The rule is the same jump from each term to the next.
images.description: Boxes 4, 7, 10, 13, 16 joined by +3 arrows with a dashed amber 19 next.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at any arrow and say the jump, then read the dashed box.

image_decisions.why: The sequence is one row with identical +3 arrows; the next term is shown as the result.
